description: the Agent Run Ledger tool exists and is executable — the durable table that joins cost telemetry to quality verdict
LEDGER: recording both runs leaves exactly two rows — one per topology, each carrying cost AND composite
command: scripts/run-ledger.sh reset >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/generalist.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/governed-team.json >/dev/null; wc -l < agentops/runs/ledger.jsonl | tr -d ' '

description: LEDGER: re-recording the same run_id does not duplicate the row — the ledger is idempotent on run_id, so a re-scored run overwrites rather than double-counts
command: scripts/run-ledger.sh reset >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/governed-team.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/governed-team.json >/dev/null; wc -l < agentops/runs/ledger.jsonl | tr -d ' '

description: TOPOLOGY CHOICE: among runs that PASS the quality bar, the cheapest is the governed team — the counterintuitive result: the governed topology is both better AND cheaper than the generalist
command: scripts/run-ledger.sh reset >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/generalist.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/governed-team.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh cheapest-passing

description: COST PER QUALITY POINT: the generalist's dollars-per-composite-point is far worse — it spends more to buy less diagnostic quality
command: scripts/run-ledger.sh reset >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/generalist.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/governed-team.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh compare | jq -r '.[] | select(.config=="generalist") | .cost_per_point'

description: COST: the governed team's absolute cost is lower than the generalist's — scoping roles kept the strong model off the cheap turns, so more governance did not mean more spend
command: scripts/run-ledger.sh reset >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/generalist.json >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh record fixtures/runs/governed-team.json >/dev/null; G=$(scripts/run-ledger.sh compare | jq -r '.[]|select(.config=="generalist")|.cost_usd'); T=$(scripts/run-ledger.sh compare | jq -r '.[]|select(.config=="governed-team")|.cost_usd'); awk -v g="$G" -v t="$T" 'BEGIN{print (t<g)?"cheaper":"not-cheaper"}'

description: FAIL-CLOSED: asking for the cheapest passing run against an empty ledger fails closed rather than inventing an answer — no data, no verdict
command: scripts/run-ledger.sh reset >/dev/null; scripts/run-ledger.sh cheapest-passing >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo failclosed || echo answered
